lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the gills. A central horizontal row contains approximately 6-7 primary nodes, with additional rows of staggered blobs positioned dorsally and ventrally along the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature runs across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient consisting of a high-luminance upper ridge and a low-luminance shadow immediately ventral.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 4-5 distinct high-luminance blobs, clustered primarily in the lower-anterior and middle regions of the fin's visible surface.
